verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows that Missive's MCP/AI integration exposes calendar scopes (calendars:read/write) for external AI apps to act on calendars, contacts and drafts, but there is no documentation of a native calendar view, invite-response UI, or event-creation UI usable directly by a human power-user inside the email client. missing for 10: dedicated calendar view/UI, RSVP/invite handling in the inbox, native event-creation flow, and any independent corroboration of these features being used day-to-day.
